why_angle: The rival pages give only rated Wh, or runtimes calculated from an assumed 85% efficiency. The only measured AC figure among them is for the Anker C300. This page collects measurements from named reviewers of what actually comes out of the AC outlet on the BLUETTI Elite 30 V2, EcoFlow RIVER 3 Plus, Anker SOLIX C300X, EcoFlow RIVER 3 and Jackery Explorer 300 Plus. It also adds two figures no rival has: the Elite 30 V2's measured 19 W AC idle drain and the RIVER 3 Plus's measured 9 ms UPS switchover.

page.title: Portable Power Station With AC Outlet: Measured AC Output (2026)
page.h1: Portable power stations with an AC outlet: how much energy actually comes out of the plug
page.desc: Reviewers measured what compact power stations deliver at the AC outlet. The BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 and EcoFlow RIVER 3 Plus each gave 231 Wh, from 600 W AC inverters. Prices checked 2026-11-13.
page.answer: Short answer. A portable power station with an AC outlet delivers about 80% of its label at the plug: the BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 gave 231 Wh at the AC outlet, matching the EcoFlow RIVER 3 Plus, with 600 W AC versus 300 W on the Anker SOLIX C300X, EcoFlow RIVER 3 and Jackery Explorer 300 Plus.

page.after:
What the differences mean

Every unit here loses part of its rated capacity on the way from the battery to the AC outlet. Plan on the measured figure, not the label:

  • BLUETTI Elite 30 V2: 231 ÷ 288 Wh = 80%. A 60 W laptop charger runs about 231 ÷ 60 ≈ 3.9 hours.
  • EcoFlow RIVER 3 Plus: 231 ÷ 286 Wh = 81%, also about 3.9 hours on 60 W. SmartZone used 330 Wh from the wall to refill it, so 231 ÷ 330 ≈ 70% round trip.
  • Anker SOLIX C300X: 300 W × 50 ÷ 60 h = 250 Wh, and 250 ÷ 288 = 87%. That is the best share here, but the inverter is rated for only 300 W.
  • EcoFlow RIVER 3: 210 ÷ 245 Wh = 86%. 210 ÷ 60 = 3.5 hours on a 60 W laptop.
  • Cost per Wh at the outlet, Elite 30 V2: $289.99 ÷ 231 Wh ≈ $1.26.
What you plug into the AC outletFitsWhy
Laptop, phone charger, router, lights (under 300 W)Any of the fourAll four deliver 210–250 Wh at the outlet. The RIVER 3 is lightest at 7.8 lb (StorageReview).
TV, monitor, fan or small appliance (300–600 W)Elite 30 V2 or RIVER 3 PlusThese are the only two rated for 600 W of continuous AC.
Three plugs at once, or more than 286 Wh laterRIVER 3 PlusIt has 3 AC outlets, and EcoFlow sells extra batteries that take it to 858 Wh.
Keeping a router or NAS on through an outageRIVER 3 Plus or Elite 30 V2StorageReview measured a 9 ms switchover on the RIVER 3 Plus. BLUETTI rates the Elite at ≤10 ms with 980 W of bypass.
Kettle, hair dryer or coffee maker at full powerNone of theseThe highest continuous AC rating here is 600 W.

How much of the rating reaches the AC outlet

The rated Wh describes the battery. The inverter that turns it into 120 V AC uses some of that energy, so the same unit gives more through DC ports. The Technology Man measured 244 Wh on DC against 231 Wh on AC from the Elite 30 V2. SmartZone got 250 Wh from the RIVER 3 Plus's 12 V socket at 120 W, against 231 Wh on AC (228 Wh at a 100 W load, 233 Wh at 600 W). nextpit measured 237 Wh from the 300 W Jackery Explorer 300 Plus (82% of 288 Wh) and needed 327 Wh to refill it, which nextpit gives as 72% round trip. SmartZone, nextpit and The Technology Man tested 230 V European and UK units.

The 600 W inverter costs no capacity. The Elite 30 V2 and RIVER 3 Plus delivered the same share of their rating as the 300 W units, and SmartZone's 600 W run on the RIVER 3 Plus returned slightly more than its 100 W run.

Idle drain is the catch with the Elite 30 V2. The Technology Man left the AC on with Eco mode off and nothing plugged in, and the battery fell from 100% to 19% in 12 hours. That is 0.81 × 288 Wh ÷ 12 h ≈ 19 W. Turn on Eco mode, or switch the AC off when nothing is plugged in. BLUETTI quotes 4.5 W standby. The 1,500 W Lifting figure is not continuous power: BLUETTI says it can reach that only momentarily, and only with purely resistive devices. Plan around 600 W. {buy:bluetti-elite-30-v2}

Not recommended

Anker SOLIX C300 DC: Anker's own spec table lists no AC output and no AC ports for the DC model. The C300 and C300X have AC outlets, so check the suffix before you buy. Jackery Explorer 300 v2: Jackery's US store marks it sold out at $299 and sends buyers to the Explorer 300. That model costs $289 with 2 AC outlets rated at 300 W, which is about the same price as the 600 W Elite 30 V2 for half the AC rating.
